name: Rift Masters Challengers 2027
overview: Rift Masters Challengers 2027 is the Tier 2 international League of Legends event of the Rift Masters series. Organized by Riot Games, it takes place in Montreal, Quebec, Canada, from September 11 to September 19, 2027, with a total prize pool of USD 300,000. Twelve teams qualify, two per region across the LCK, LPL, LEC, LCS, LCP and CBLOL. Academy Blue and White have no automatic qualification.
format: Two teams per region across LCK, LPL, LEC, LCS, LCP and CBLOL.
